description: This file defines the DataReaderV1 class, which implements the IDataReader interface for reading media data segments. It includes a nested MetadataV1 struct for holding metadata about media samples, and provides methods for reading data and creating media segments based on metadata. The class is part of the firebolt::rialto::server namespace and is used for handling media stream data in a media server context.

classes.name: DataReaderV1
classes.description: A class that reads media data segments from a buffer, using metadata to create media segment objects.

methods.name: DataReaderV1
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DataReaderV1 with media source type, buffer, metadata offset, and number of frames.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads and returns a vector of media segments based on the stored metadata.

methods.name: createSegment
methods.description: Template method that creates a media segment of a specified type using metadata and buffer data.
